independent_findings.source_reading: TBX share is a verb for making resources available to others; digital image is a singular noun. OU p616 saving and p151 done are the exact chosen forms. The adjacent saved/rescue-related family is not substituted, and the separate Save command is not mislabeled as a participle.
independent_findings.caller_meaning: writeImage completes its stream copy before calling shareSavedImage. The title identifies a saved object for prospective sharing, not completed sharing, automatic transmission, delivery, or receipt.
independent_findings.limits: The parenthesized status qualifies the image and the saving operation. This is functional authored status composition, not a source-attested inflected phrase equivalent to saved image.

independent_findings.backtranslation: Image: select (minimum: 1). In this checkbox context, image(s) is the intended counted category.
independent_findings.source_reading: TBX select is explicitly a verb for marking items and adding checks to checkboxes. OU p454 minimum is exact, with no POS label supplied. TBX image is singular metadata, not a claimed plural-attested noun; contextual number is handled without invented morphology.
independent_findings.caller_meaning: ImageCropDialog 145 rejects an empty selected set before applying crop; its checkbox subset may contain several images. ImageAssembly 155 rejects an empty ID set. Minimum 1 preserves any nonempty subset, rather than exactly one, a maximum, or image dimensions.
independent_findings.limits: Nominal category plus action and numerical minimum is an authored UI instruction. No new plural finite verb or native-human grammatical certification is claimed.

independent_findings.source_reading: OU p227 includes the exact first form in an adjective entry and a duplicate unqualified first entry. It is used as a separated step heading, not silently converted to an adjective describing which image. TBX tap is explicitly a verb for a brief fingertip or stylus press on a UI element.
independent_findings.caller_meaning: AssemblyActivity 99–100 shows this when Unplace or Remove has no selected image. Board selection and thumbnail selection provide the prerequisite. It asks for a first action on an existing assembly image, not import, double-tap, or selecting the first image in list order.
independent_findings.limits: Tap is retained as the exact UI action term, not a newly fabricated finite imperative. The punctuation carries the step-heading structure; the full sentence is not source-attested.

direct_callers.exact_line: estimate.text = if (size == null) ui(R.string.ui_enter_valid_dimensions) else ui(R.string.ui_estimated_memory_current_working_budget, memoryLabel(renderer.estimatedBytes(size)), memoryLabel(ImageMemoryPolicy.forDevice(this).workingBytes.toDouble())) + if (renderer.fits(size)) ui(R.string.ui_fits_the_current_budget) else ui(R.string.ui_choose_a_smaller_size)

independent_findings.source_reading: OU p647 explicitly supplies noun size; p421 supplies less, with no POS or complete comparative construction specified. OU p99 visually attests ᎭᏑᏯᎩ as the whole transitive command choose it (imperative), distinguishing the nearby choose him/her form. TBX independently attests the same choose form in a GUI-option sense.
independent_findings.caller_meaning: AssemblyActivity 311 appends the warning to the current estimate when renderer.fits(sizing.dimensions) is false. DimensionControls exposes the current attempted geometric output dimensions; the creation button is disabled until a fitting size is chosen. The comparison anchor is that currently evaluated size.
independent_findings.limits: The comparative less is explicitly scoped to size by the parenthesis, so it asks for a lesser size relative to the current unsuccessful attempt rather than an arbitrary absolute small category. It is prospective choice, not completed reduction. The complete comparative construction is authored, not attested; this contextual reading is the bounded acceptance basis.
